1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" in the HTML
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
7: 
8: // Ship state
9: const ship = {
10:   x: canvas.width / 2,
11:   y: canvas.height / 2,
12:   angle: 0,
13:   vx: 0,
14:   vy: 0,
15:   radius: 10,
16:   thrust: 0.1,
17:   rotateSpeed: 0.07,
18: };
19: 
20: let fuel = 100; // percent
21: let asteroids = [];
22: let gameOver = false;
23: let lastSpawn = 0;
24: 
25: function spawnAsteroid() {
26:   const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
27:   let x, y, vx, vy;
28:   const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
29:   switch (edge) {
30:     case 0: // top
31:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = -20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed; break;
32:     case 1: // right
33:       x = canvas.width + 20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; break;
34:     case 2: // bottom
35:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = canvas.height + 20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = -speed; break;
36:     case 3: // left
37:       x = -20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; break;
38:   }
39:   asteroids.push({x, y, vx, vy, r: 15 + Math.random() * 20});
40: }
41: 
42: function update(dt) {
43:   if (gameOver) return;
44:   // Controls
45:   if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
46:   if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
47:   if (keys['ArrowUp'] && fuel > 0) {
48:     ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
49:     ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
50:     fuel -= dt * 0.01; // fuel consumption
51:   }
52:   // Move ship
53:   ship.x += ship.vx;
54:   ship.y += ship.vy;
55:   // Screen wrap for ship
56:   if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += canvas.width;
57:   if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x -= canvas.width;
58:   if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += canvas.height;
59:   if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y -= canvas.height;
60:   // Update asteroids
61:   for (let a of asteroids) {
62:     a.x += a.vx;
63:     a.y += a.vy;
64:     // wrap
65:     if (a.x < -30) a.x += canvas.width + 60;
66:     if (a.x > canvas.width + 30) a.x -= canvas.width + 60;
67:     if (a.y < -30) a.y += canvas.height + 60;
68:     if (a.y > canvas.height + 30) a.y -= canvas.height + 60;
69:   }
70:   // Collision detection
71:   for (let a of asteroids) {
72:     const dx = a.x - ship.x;
73:     const dy = a.y - ship.y;
74:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
75:     if (dist < a.r + ship.radius) {
76:       gameOver = true;
77:     }
78:   }
79:   // Fuel out
80:   if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
81:   // Spawn new asteroids periodically
82:   if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > 2000) {
83:     spawnAsteroid();
84:     lastSpawn = performance.now();
85:   }
86: }
87: 
88: function draw() {
89:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
90:   // Ship
91:   ctx.save();
92:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
93:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
94:   ctx.beginPath();
95:   ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
96:   ctx.lineTo(-10, -7);
97:   ctx.lineTo(-10, 7);
98:   ctx.closePath();
99:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
100:   ctx.fill();
101:   ctx.restore();
102:   // Asteroids
103:   ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
104:   for (let a of asteroids) {
105:     ctx.beginPath();
106:     ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
107:     ctx.fill();
108:   }
109:   // UI
110:   ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
111:   ctx.font = '16px monospace';
112:   ctx.fillText('Fuel: ' + Math.max(0, fuel).toFixed(0) + '%', 10, 20);
113:   if (gameOver) {
114:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
115:     ctx.font = '48px monospace';
116:     ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', canvas.width / 2 - 150, canvas.height / 2);
117:   }
118: }
119: 
120: let lastTime = 0;
121: function loop(timestamp) {
122:   const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
123:   lastTime = timestamp;
124:   update(dt);
125:   draw();
126:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
127: }
128: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
129: 
130: // Input handling
131: const keys = {};
132: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {keys[e.key] = true;});
133: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {keys[e.key] = false;});
